description: Shared wire definitions for Hypercerts feed procedures.

maearthFeed.description: Experimental MaEarth Following feed; MaEarth hydrates and filters visibility.

maearthFeedParams.description: Viewer-scoped Following parameters. Anonymous requests require viewerDid; service-auth requests use the verified issuer. actorDid only narrows this scope.

kinds.description: Omitted or empty selects all kinds. Account follows are not classified as people versus organizations.

maearthActor.description: The account that authored the item's own record: the poster, follower or reposter, which is the authority of the entry's subject URI. The object is open: clients must ignore fields they do not know, and later versions may add some (for example a handle).

maearthTarget.description: What a repost or follow item points at. Exactly one field is set, by item kind: uri for a repost (the original attachment) and for a projectFollow (the followed org.hypercerts.collection); did for an accountFollow (the followed account). This service enforces that; the schema leaves both optional so new target shapes can be added. The target is not fetched. The object is open: clients must ignore fields they do not know.

maearthFeedView.description: Experimental merge metadata, not hydrated content, plus engagement counts for post and repost items. Items dated more than five minutes after the database's statement time are not returned. MaEarth must apply privacy and content filtering. Clients must ignore fields they do not know.

createdAt.description: The item record's own createdAt, returned exactly as the record wrote it (not reformatted or converted to UTC). Omitted when the record has no createdAt or its value is not a valid datetime; there is no substitute. It is not the sort time: items are ordered by createdAt or, when that is unusable, by the time the record was indexed, so an item without createdAt can still appear in order.

cid.description: CID of the item's own record, the entry's subject URI. Optional; this service sets it for every kind.

actor.description: The item record's author. Set for every kind.

target.description: What a repost or follow item points at. Present for repost, projectFollow and accountFollow; absent for post.

likeCount.description: Number of distinct accounts with a current like of the counted post. Present, possibly 0, only for post and repost items. A repost item counts its original post (target.uri), not the repost record. A current count at response time, not a snapshot.

repostCount.description: Number of distinct accounts with a current repost of the counted post. Present, possibly 0, only for post and repost items; counted post as for likeCount.

replyCount.description: Number of current direct replies to the counted post: comment attachments listing it in subjects. Every comment record counts, not distinct authors, and replies to replies are excluded. Present, possibly 0, only for post and repost items; counted post as for likeCount.

hypercertsFeed.description: Identifies the Hypercerts viewer-scope feed algorithm.

hypercertsFeedParams.description: Parameters accepted by the Hypercerts viewer-scope feed algorithm. Anonymous requests must provide viewerDid; authenticated service requests may omit it.

viewerDid.description: Viewer whose current Certified follows supply the base author scope. Required for anonymous requests; authenticated service requests use the verified issuer when omitted.

trustedEvaluators.description: Evaluator DIDs whose active endorsement subjects extend the author scope.

kinds.description: Final event kinds to include. Omitted or empty means every supported kind.

organizationQualityPolicy.description: Controls which known organizations qualify before event pagination.

allowed.description: Organization quality values allowed into the feed.

includeUnrated.description: Whether known organizations without an active trusted quality label qualify.

actorSummary.description: A feed actor's DID and, when meaningful, validated Certified-profile display fields.

hypercertsFeedView.description: Hydrated representation of one entry from the Hypercerts viewer-scope feed.

kind.description: Hypercerts event classification used to interpret and present the entry.

content.description: Kind-specific content needed to present the entry.
